## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1
- dd-2
- dd-3
- dd-5
- dd-6
- dd-7
- dd-4 (sub-partition: override-effect boundary crossing): a config override of migration.call_site_threshold moves a borderline target ACROSS the classification boundary (sweep ↔ not-sweep). The default/floor helper behavior half of dd-4 is owned by task-1.

Create plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/migration-class-detect.sh, which consumes get_call_site_threshold() (from task-1) to classify a target's migration class from its call-site count, plus the behavioral test plugins/dso/tests/implementation-plan/test-migration-class-detect.sh. The override-effect boundary crossing is now explicitly owned and tested here: running the detector against a fixed N-call-site fixture must flip the migration-class field between sweep and not-sweep as the configured threshold crosses the fixture's N.

## TDD Test Spec
Given a fixed fixture with exactly N call sites; When migration-class-detect.sh runs with migration.call_site_threshold set to N+1; Then the migration-class field is NOT sweep. And When the same fixture is detected with migration.call_site_threshold set to N-1; Then the migration-class field flips to sweep — proving a config override moves a borderline target across the classification boundary.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] migration-class-detect behavioral suite reports FAILED: 0.
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/implementation-plan/test-migration-class-detect.sh | grep -qE 'FAILED:[[:space:]]*0'
- [ ] dd-4 override-effect boundary crossing: running migration-class-detect.sh against a fixed N-call-site fixture twice flips the migration-class field — threshold N+1 yields NOT sweep, threshold N-1 yields sweep.
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/implementation-plan/test-migration-class-detect.sh | grep -qiE 'boundary.crossing|threshold.flip|override.effect'
- [ ] Detector script carries the executable bit.
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/migration-class-detect.sh && test -x plugins/dso/tests/implementation-plan/test-migration-class-detect.sh

## File Impact
- Create: plugins/dso/scripts/implementation-plan/migration-class-detect.sh
- Create: plugins/dso/tests/implementation-plan/test-migration-class-detect.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
